status: Declared expectations only. This plan executes nothing, records no result, and is not the runtime source of the commands; the commands are fixed by source/witness-contract.md and executed as admitted C2 command-execution observations.

declaredCommands.purpose: Execution proof: run the CLI and observe stdout exactly "Hello, world!\n" (OS:L13, OS:L34); carrier of assertedReturnValue (OS:L76). TD CHK-CLI-1.
Run the component and UAT verifiers against the current CLI (OS:L72-73). TD TC-COMP-1 and TC-UAT-1.

requiredPassingTests.name: CLI process satisfies its output contract
a user receives the exact promised greeting

coverage.floor: expectedTestPassCount = 2: one component test plus one UAT test (OS:L74, OR:minimumTestPasses). The exact pass count is not pinned, so added depth tests remain admissible (OS:L75).
coverage.pairing: Both requiredPassingTests must be reported passing by name in the same admitted run of command 'tests'. Exit 0 alone, UAT alone, or an aggregate count without both names is insufficient (PC R-12, WC:L78-79).

observedResultCriteria.observationSource: Admitted C2 command-execution observations (contract://abiogenesis/worksite/command-execution-observation@5) of declaredCommands 'cli' and 'tests', whose recorded files carry the same current generated/hello-world.mjs digest and the requiredPassingTests source digests.
observedResultCriteria.observedTestPassCount: Integer N from the 'tests' stdout summary line matching /^(?:ℹ|#) pass (\d+)$/m.
observedResultCriteria.observedTestFailCount: Integer N from the 'tests' stdout summary line matching /^(?:ℹ|#) fail (\d+)$/m.
observedResultCriteria.namedTestPassed: The 'tests' stdout has a line beginning '✔ <name>' (spec) or 'ok <n> - <name>' (TAP), and no line beginning '✖ <name>' or 'not ok <n> - <name>'.
planSatisfied: neither observation timedOut or has a processSignal
both observations record the same current CLI digest and the requiredPassingTests sha256 values
observedResultCriteria.otherwise: Reject. A failing observation stays as evidence and is never a reason to relax an expectation, edit a test source or change the oracle (PC R-15, WC:L92-94).
observedResultCriteria.evaluator: Independent assessment over admitted evidence (OS:L82-86 test_execution_result produces no files). Not this plan and not its author.

resultCarrier.disposition: Not authored. The original's handwritten execution-result file and worker-run execution (OS:L68-78) are carried by admitted C2 command-execution observations recording the real command, args, cwd, env, integer status, stdout and stderr; expectedTestPassCount, expectedStdoutMatch and assertedReturnValue come from this plan (PC C-1, C-2, R-10; WC:L58-63; OR:assessment).

currentness.subject: generated/hello-world.mjs as recorded by digest in the admitted observations at execution time. This plan does not pin CLI bytes.
currentness.historical: Observations of an earlier CLI digest, including the baseline sha256:647697a5fb5d141a2b1163363170a7a845b61a36096ff52f7a369f1736cd4993 (command 'tests' exit 1, pass 0, fail 2), are retained as revision-lineage counterevidence and can neither satisfy nor refute this plan for the current subject (PC R-13).
invalidatedBy: a change to either requiredPassingTests source digest
a change to any basis digest
a change to the CLI digest after the admitted observations (the observations become historical; the plan stays valid)
